Api.//: Absolute base URL of the Crawldad API the portal calls through Crawldad.Client. Dev default is the API's local http profile; override per environment (e.g. Crawldad__Api__BaseUrl).

DataProtection.//: Persists the portal's ASP.NET Data Protection key ring so its auth cookies + antiforgery tokens survive a container restart/replace (issue #119 — the retired stored-key path means the ring no longer protects any tenant API key). This is the portal's OWN section + OWN ring, isolated from the API's Crawldad:DataProtection. BOTH set (the Azure deployment) => the key ring is stored in the KeyRingBlobUri blob (the portal's own container) and each key is wrapped by the KeyVaultKeyId Key Vault key, authenticated by the app's managed identity (set AZURE_CLIENT_ID for the user-assigned identity). BOTH empty (dev/test default) => the framework's default local key ring. Half-set fails fast at startup. The infra deploy feeds these via Crawldad__Portal__DataProtection__* env vars.

Email.//: The production email provider (Postmark) for sign-in OTP delivery (issue #119). BOTH ServerToken and FromAddress set => PostmarkEmailSender is used in ANY environment (so a real token can smoke-test sign-in locally). BOTH empty (dev/test default) => no provider: the dev LoggingEmailSender in Development, the fail-closed UnconfiguredEmailSender elsewhere. Setting only one fails fast at startup. ServerToken is a secret — supply it by reference to a Key Vault secret via Crawldad__Portal__Email__ServerToken, NEVER committed here. The infra deploy feeds these via Crawldad__Portal__Email__* env vars (FromAddress + MessageStream plain, ServerToken from Key Vault).

ConnectionStrings.//: Same shared devcontainer Postgres the API uses (throwaway dev credential); the portal isolates itself in the "portal" schema. Override with the ConnectionStrings__marten env var. Never commit real secrets.
